title: The Companion Who Turned Away
intro: You are about to uncover the story of a soul who lived in the shadow of prophethood yet chose a path that led to ruin. This figure shared a home with one of Allah's chosen messengers but failed the test of faith. Who is this lost companion?
clues: I lived among people who rejected the call to righteousness, and I did not oppose them.
I was married to a prophet of Allah, but I did not share the belief.
When the messengers came to my home with a warning, I did not believe them.
My spouse was commanded to leave the city with the believers, and I was not among them.
The punishment descended upon my people, and I was destroyed along with them.
I am mentioned in the Quran as an example of disbelief, alongside the wife of Nuh, in Surah At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Rejected the message of Prophet Hud
Worshipped idols openly in the Kaaba
Refused to accept her son's prophethood

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
